title: DNAgents #4 Eclipse Comics 1983 Mark Evanier Will Meugniot Amber Backup
conditionDescription: Bright, clean covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
DNAgents #4 (July 1983), Eclipse Comics - "Who killed Angela Krell the first time?" Plus: Amber meets the Man with the Vision! Written by Mark Evanier, art and cover by Will Meugniot and Al Gordon. Baxter paper, $1.50 cover price.

Back cover: Ms. Tree (Max Collins and Terry Beatty) ad.

Condition: bright, clean covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
